description: Finance value signals the xiaolin_finance plugin amplifies. Each rule declares the domain_extension section it feeds, so the distilled taxonomy is inspectable data rather than code.

sections.business_mechanism: How a business earns money and how value, cost and incentive connect.
sections.financial_structure: How a report is organised: revenue, cost, growth sources and risk factors.
sections.data_expression_pattern: How numbers are expressed: comparison, trend, indicator interpretation.
sections.case_selection_logic: Why a company case is chosen and how it supports the claim.
sections.misconception_analysis: Which common belief is wrong and where fact diverges from perception.

rules.label: Business mechanism
rules.rationale: Explain how value, revenue, costs, and incentives connect.

rules.label: Financial statement structure
rules.rationale: Prefer a report structure built from revenue, cost, growth sources, and named risk factors instead of a headline number.

rules.label: Data interpretation
rules.rationale: Prefer interpretable data with units, periods, and comparisons.

rules.label: Company case
rules.rationale: Use company cases to make a mechanism concrete without generalizing beyond evidence.

rules.label: Misconception analysis
rules.rationale: Name the common belief, then separate the observed fact from the perception without ridiculing the audience.
